mapper.sql: c.id, c.owner_id, c.title, c.algorithm, c.archive_id, c.calendar, c.gender, c.birth_year, c.birth_month, c.birth_day, c.birth_hour, c.birth_minute, c.birth_place, c.client_name, c.question, c.notes, c.reading, c.payload, c.created_at AS created_unix, c.updated_at AS updated_unix

sql.if: AND (c.title LIKE #{keyword} OR c.client_name LIKE #{keyword} OR c.question LIKE #{keyword})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chart_case_tag ct WHERE ct.case_id = c.id AND ct.tag_id = #{tag_id})

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM chart_case c
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM chart_case c
mapper.sql: a.archive_id, a.algorithm, a.title, a.owner_id, a.size_bytes, a.created_at AS created_unix
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM chart_archive_index a
ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.archive_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM chart_archive_index a
mapper.sql: id, name, color, owner_id, created_at AS created_unix
mapper.select: SELECT FROM chart_tag ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chart_archive_index (archive_id, algorithm, title, owner_id, size_bytes, payload, created_at) VALUES (#{archive_id}, #{algorithm}, #{title}, #{owner_id}, #{size_bytes}, #{payload}, #{created_at}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE algorithm = VALUES(algorithm), title = VALUES(title), owner_id = VALUES(owner_id), size_bytes = VALUES(size_bytes), payload = VALUES(payload)
mapper.select: SELECT algorithm, COUNT(*) AS total FROM chart_archive_index GROUP BY algorithm ORDER BY algorithm ASC
